Application Data.NAME: Learning Tree Supplies, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Learning Tree Supplies, LLC is a retail operation focused on offering a diverse range of educational materials, school supplies, and art supplies to local schools and families. The business primarily sells physical items such as textbooks, stationery, art materials, and educational games. With a well-organized inventory system valued under $500,000, we maintain manageable stock levels to reduce loss exposure. We also have a minimal online sales presence, accounting for less than 25% of total revenue, allowing us to mitigate cyber and fulfillment risks. Our store is equipped with standard security features, including locked display cases and adequate lighting, to protect against theft and damage. Additionally, we do not engage in equipment rentals or in-store instructional activities, reducing potential liability exposures associated with those services.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a theft incident occurred at our retail location, resulting in the loss of various school supplies valued at $3,000. The stolen items included textbooks, stationery, and art materials. The incident was reported to local authorities, and we have since installed additional security measures. The claim is currently under review with a status of "Pending." Additionally, on July 10, 2023, we experienced minor water damage due to a leak in the ceiling, causing damages estimated at $2,000. This incident has been resolved with repairs completed, and no claims were filed for this event.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class B Safe, UL Listed, Fire Resistant, 750 lb Capacity
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Centrally monitored alarm system, security personnel on site during operating hours, and fenced perimeter around the property.
